justification: Audits LLM self-verification as the judgement in a plan-generation loop, scoring the verifier against ground truth and varying feedback level; GPT-4 lab study of a technique not used in practice.

Contribution is an automatically generated self-correction guideline that shapes how failed SQL is revised, not the check itself; evaluated only in lab text-to-SQL experiments against expert-written guidelines.
Headline artefact is CriticBench, a 15-dataset instrument for measuring generate-critique-correct behaviour across 17 LLMs; measurement is done in the lab, not in a deployed setting.
Studies whether self-reflection-driven rewriting helps at all once external feedback is disallowed, and when to use it; lab runs on TruthfulQA and HotpotQA, no practice setting.
Contribution is delta-view feedback and the fault-localisation/repair step that rewrites incorrect LaTeX, i.e. the revision after a diff; validated in the lab against GPT-4V by exact-match accuracy.
Query2CAD's claim is its self-refinement loop that rewrites CAD macros from BLIP2 feedback; a prototype measured on an authors' dataset of CAD operations, not deployed with practitioners.
Analyses self-repair, i.e. what happens after a failing test, and locates the bottleneck in feedback quality; lab measurements on HumanEval and APPS with Code Llama, GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.
Actor-Critic loop whose critic is an off-the-shelf ASP solver while the claim is the iterative refinement from test-failure feedback; validated in the lab on the FOLIO benchmark.
Targets the feedback-quality bottleneck in reflection by contrasting perspectives into a checklist that drives re-examination; lab experiments on reasoning and translation tasks only.
AlphaLLM's claim is an outer self-improving loop that upgrades the model from its own MCTS trajectories without annotations; MCTS is the means. Lab evaluation on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

Contrasts coarse-grained with fine-grained feedback and formulates detected inconsistencies into feedback that guides solution revision; lab results on seven arithmetic datasets. Runner-up: verification_and_gating.
Contribution is the agent arrangement itself, comparing an initializer-critic-scorer trio against an initializer-critic pair; lab benchmarking of TSP/mTSP against Google OR-Tools.

Contribution is an automatically generated self-correction guideline that shapes how failed SQL is revised, not the check itself; evaluated only in lab text-to-SQL experiments against expert-written guidelines.
Maps the steering feedback experts give to make a model rewrite failing code onto five Socratic stages; evidence is 30 study transcripts on contrived programming challenges, not production use.
Contribution is a cyclical evaluate-and-refine strategy for rewriting generated scenarios; the loop is run for real IPE course material and judged by clinical evaluators and blinded students.
Claim is that self-correction must change the model itself: SCL trains a VLM on its own self-correction traces via DPO rather than refining at inference; lab benchmarks on vision-language reasoning.

SR-MCTS changes the shape of exploration over solution paths and a pairwise reward model ranks candidates globally; lab benchmarking on GPQA, AIME24 and AMC23.
Contribution is the peer-review arrangement itself: who reviews whom, confidence-weighted reviews and feedback exchange versus solution sharing; lab experiments across ten reasoning datasets.
ToT's contribution is branching over candidate thoughts with self-evaluated lookahead and backtracking to pick the next step; a prototype measured on Game of 24, Creative Writing and Mini Crosswords.

AlphaVerus bootstraps itself across iterations, accumulating verified translations that improve later generations without finetuning or humans; lab evaluation on HumanEval and MBPP. Runner-up: deliberative_search.
GIF-MCTS is a candidate generation-expansion-selection strategy over code world models; validated in the lab on the authors' CWMB suite and two further benchmarks.
Tests whether small models can rewrite an unethical output when given natural-language feedback, varying scale, safety alignment and instruction type in prompting experiments; lab only.
Volcano generates natural-language self-feedback and revises its own initial response to remove hallucination; lab benchmarking on MMHal-Bench, POPE, GAVIE, MM-Vet and MMBench.

Contribution is the refinement schedule: which problems get refined, how errors are localised by a reward model, and how many rounds; lab evaluation on seven reasoning datasets with Llama-3-8B and GPT-3.5.
